cer_bossmenu.changelog: [cer_bossmenu v1.4.4] Significant security enhancements, improved DB query hardening, and several minor bug fixes.

cer_elevators.changelog: [cer_elevators v1.3.1] Add adaptive target and textui integrations, A reusable web TextUI store and component for clean interaction prompts and key badges in the NUI shell.

cer_donations.changelog: [cer_donations v1.0.1] Add configurable inventory and interaction bridges, Adapters for six inventory resources and custom inventory templates.
